Name: Rainbow Fairy Mushroom Trees for Alternative Textures
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
Hi there! this is my first mod so please feel  free to share comments/questions in the posts section!

I love Lumiepop's Fairy Mushroom Trees but I wanted to have many colors to choose from, so I messaged them here on Nexus to obtain permission to recolor her tree and upload it here for y'all! Please check out her original mod here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9640

Currently there are 11 textures in a variety of colors. I hope they help you live your best mushroom farmer lives :)

MODS IN SCREENSHOT:

DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor
Simple Foliage
IdaIda's Seasonal Gothic Buildings
Solip's Coop Animals
Flowergrass and Snowfields
Stone Fence Retexture (this one is from KAYA it's on her wesbite https://kayainsdv.postype.com/}
